notes: "What happens" takes the licensed (Member $e $verb) shape, "at the base of the cliff" the event Location plus the part-whole PartOf genitive with both definites bound by kind (neither is in the context), and "by autumn" the TimeAtMost deadline with its dual-storage twin. The union's coverage is narrower than "at or before autumn" only because no season ordering is licensed.
